column1: # IEEE 1800-2009 Annex K (vpi_user.h), Annex L (vpi_compatibility.h) and Annex M
# (sv_vpi_user.h), derived once from the standard text and checked in so tests never read
# docs/specification. Columns: annex, line of SystemVerilog-1800-2009.txt (pdftotext -layout),
# kind (define/struct/routine/functype), class (std, alias = defined as another name,
# deprecated = marked deprecated in 1800-2009, compat = Annex L compatibility-mode rename,
# platform = linkage macro), name, value (define: value with whitespace removed; struct:
# member names; routine/functype: return type and parameter types).
